other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir.
Applicant must have a bank account with Aadhaar linked to it to enroll in PMSBY or PMJJBY.
Applicant must provide a nominee’s name in the enrollment form.
Applicant must submit an income certificate proving annual income less than ₹75,000 and no other source of income.
The premium will be auto‑debited from the applicant’s bank account each year.
Eligibility category noted in source: widows
Eligibility category noted in source: destitute
Eligibility category noted in source: breadwinners
benefits_summary: The government bears the premium for PMSBY and PMJJBY for up to five years, providing life/accident cover to eligible widows, destitute, BPL families and their breadwinners.
